notes.title: Negative Atmosphere: Emergency Room™ - Announcement Trailer (2023)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5xrdhtgAiBs;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2112380/Negative_Atmosphere_Emergency_Room/]NEGATIVE ATMOSPHERE: ER - STEAM PAGE[/url]
Negative Atmosphere: Emergency Room is a [b]FREE[/b], stand-alone, cinematic medical horror experience covering the events that lead to Negative Atmosphere. 

[b]Coming to Steam Early Access, early 2023.[/b]

As the Chief Medical Officer on the TRH Rusanov, Samuel Edwards must triage, examine and operate on his crew-mates.

Witness the Rusanov’s descent into madness first-hand, as you struggle to keep everyone alive with the limited resources you have at your disposal.

notes.title: Negative Atmosphere™ - Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=h-BwKzX21d0;full][/previewyoutube]
Negative Atmosphere is a third person, over-the-shoulder survival horror game dedicated to dread, tension and trauma. Trapped aboard the voidship TRH Rusanov, Samuel Edwards must evade, fight and kill his former crew-mates as an outbreak transforms them into monsters. There's only one way out and an entire ship to cross. Danger lurks around every corner and time is running out.  Explore the depths of the Rusanov, pull whatever resources you can out of its guts, and run. 

We can't wait to offer more info in the future. 
For now, make sure to follow our socials for all the latest updates and info.
